title: 有馬記念の後に・最高の手ごたえ

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The Arima Kinen—a momentous race where the best of the best come together…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: There, Maruzensky shows the world a run that fills other athletes with inspiration and motivation.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: After such a fulfilling race, she believes that she'll continue to enjoy running from here on out.
